requirements.quote: Students can enrol in courses and view course materials.
Instructors can upload videos, slides and assignments.
Videos must be encoded so they play on low bandwidth connections.
Students must score at least 40% to pass a course.
Students must score at least 50% to pass a course.
The system must generate certificates for completed courses.
The portal must support 2,000 concurrent students without degradation.
The system relies on the college single sign on service.
